messages:
Maya: Quick UX flag — legend feels disconnected from the timeline on medium viewports. Figma: https://figma.com/file/redwood/trace-legend-ideas :mag:
Samir: Agreed. Proposal: collapsible left rail for legend; default collapsed under 900px to save vertical space.
Anne: Accessibility: if we add a left rail, set role="navigation" and aria-label="Trace legend"; ensure it is reachable early in the tab order.
Claire: Copy icon ambiguity: users think it downloads. Suggest labelled action `Copy trace link` on hover and permanent sr-only text for screen readers. Also show the short id under the action.
Eduardo: Permalink generation note: backend issues mean permalinks are only created after persistence. Disable copy until ready and use aria-live to announce `Permalink generating...`. Consider a toast that updates with full link when available.
Priya: I'll schedule a short a11y sweep on staging once the branch lands — focus order, live region messages, and contrast for legend swatches are my priorities.
deploy-bot: Deployed trace-legend-rail prototype to staging at 2025-01-10T12:00:00Z :rocket:
Maya: Action items: (1) Claire to update Figma with rail + labelled copy affordance, (2) Samir to implement rail and disabled-state copy, (3) Anne to validate keyboard flow, (4) Priya to run a11y pass. Will close after staging pass.
